name: Offering memorandum (sale)
what: The seller's or listing broker's marketing package for a property: description, rent roll summary, operating history and pricing guidance.

fields.label: Listing broker
fields.definition: The brokerage and the agents named as the contacts for the offering.

fields.label: Date received
fields.definition: The date the package was received, and the issue date printed on it if there is one.

fields.label: Property
fields.definition: The address, property type and a short description of the buildings and land as the memorandum presents them.

fields.label: Building area
fields.definition: The building square feet stated; note whether it is rentable or gross area and check it against the rent roll.

fields.label: Land area
fields.definition: The site size as stated, in acres or square feet, with the unit.

fields.label: Year built
fields.definition: The year built, and any renovation year the memorandum gives.

fields.label: Asking price
fields.definition: The stated asking price; null when the offering is unpriced.

fields.label: Pricing guidance
fields.definition: Any price, cap rate or per-square-foot guidance given in place of an asking price, and where it was given.

fields.label: Occupancy
fields.definition: The share of the building stated as leased or occupied, and the date it speaks to.

fields.label: Stated net operating income
fields.definition: The net operating income the memorandum headlines.

fields.label: Basis of stated NOI
fields.definition: What the stated income is: trailing actual, in-place annualized, year-one projected or stabilized pro forma, read from the table's heading and notes.

fields.label: Stated cap rate
fields.definition: The cap rate the memorandum shows, with the income and price it is figured on.

fields.label: Tenant summary
fields.definition: Each tenant the memorandum lists with its area, rent, expense basis and lease expiration, marked with the page it came from.

fields.label: Upside presented
fields.definition: What the broker presents as upside, such as rents below market, vacant space or excess land; treat it as the seller's claim until tested.

fields.label: Offer process
fields.definition: Tour dates, the call-for-offers date, what an offer must include, and any confidentiality agreement the package requires.
